title: Grade 10 MUSIC AND DANCE — General Assessment #9

pages.quiz:
MUSIC AND DANCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the costume

2. Best practice when working on Transposition: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Transposition with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Transposition.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Transposition.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Transposition.

3. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software.
   C. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software.
   D. Practise Music Notation Software with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Melody in Major Keys: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody in Major Keys.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody in Major Keys.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody in Major Keys.
   D. Practise Melody in Major Keys with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Setting Text to Music: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Setting Text to Music.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Setting Text to Music.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Setting Text to Music.

6. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.
   D. Practise Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Western Style Solo Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Western Style Solo Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Western Style Solo Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Western Style Solo Songs.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Western Style Solo Songs.

8. Best practice when working on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   B. Damage equipment used for Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   D. Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   C. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.

10. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Replace drinking water

11. Best practice when working on Dance Production: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Dance Production.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Dance Production.
   C. Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Dance Production.

12. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   D. Practise Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Music Notation Software and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Dance Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — The speed of the music

2. A — Practise Transposition with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. D — Practise Music Notation Software with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. D — Practise Melody in Major Keys with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. A — Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. D — Practise Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. A — Practise Western Style Solo Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. D — Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. C — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. B — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

11. C — Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. D — Practise Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Music Notation Software; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Dance Production; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
